text_en: David again gathered all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.
text_cn: 达味又调集了以色列所有的精兵，共三万人。

text_en: David and all the people with him set out and went from Baale-judah, to bring up from there the ark of God, which is called by the name of the Lord of hosts who is enthroned on the cherubim.
text_cn: 达味和他身边所有的人，起身到犹大巴阿拉去，要从那里将天主的约柜运上来。这约柜名叫“坐于革鲁宾上的万军的上主。”

text_en: They carried the ark of God on a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab, which was on the hill. Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, were driving the new cart
text_cn: 人遂将天主的约柜，从丘陵上的阿彼纳达布家里抬出，放在一辆新车上，阿彼纳达布的两个儿子，乌匝和阿希约驾驶新车。

text_en: with the ark of God; and Ahio went in front of the ark.
text_cn: 乌匝走在天主约柜的后面，阿希约走在前面。

text_en: David and all the house of Israel were dancing before the Lord with all their might, with songs and lyres and harps and tambourines and castanets and cymbals.
text_cn: 达味和以色列全家在上主面前兴高采烈地舞蹈作乐，弹琴、击弦、敲鼓、摇铃、击钹。

text_en: When they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah reached out his hand to the ark of God and took hold of it, for the oxen shook it.
text_cn: 当他们来到纳贡的禾场时，因为牛几乎使天主的约柜倾倒，乌匝便伸手扶住。

text_en: The anger of the Lord was kindled against Uzzah; and God struck him there because he reached out his hand to the ark; and he died there beside the ark of God.
text_cn: 为了他一时的冒失，上主就向乌匝发怒，将他击杀，他便死在天主的约柜旁。

text_en: David was angry because the Lord had burst forth with an outburst upon Uzzah; so that place is called Perez-uzzah, to this day.
text_cn: 达味因为上主击杀了乌匝，很觉悲伤，于是那地方名叫培勒兹乌匝，直到今日。

text_en: David was afraid of the Lord that day; he said, “How can the ark of the Lord come into my care? ”
text_cn: 那天，达味对上主害了怕，心想：“上主的约柜如何能进入我那里？”

text_en: So David was unwilling to take the ark of the Lord into his care in the city of David; instead David took it to the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
text_cn: 因此，达味不愿上主的约柜迁入达味城自己那里，却运往加特人敖贝得厄东家中。

text_en: The ark of the Lord remained in the house of Obed-edom the Gittite three months; and the Lord blessed Obed-edom and all his household.
text_cn: 上主的约柜在加特人敖贝得厄东家中，存放了三个月，上主祝福了敖贝得厄东和他的全家。

text_en: It was told King David, “The Lord has blessed the household of Obed-edom and all that belongs to him, because of the ark of God. ” So David went and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obed-edom to the city of David with rejoicing;
text_cn: 有人告诉达味，上主为了天主的约柜祝福了敖贝得厄东的家，和他所有的一切。达味就去将天主的约柜，由敖贝得厄东家兴高采烈地抬上达味城来。

text_en: and when those who bore the ark of the Lord had gone six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fatling.
text_cn: 每当抬上主约柜的人走六步，他就祭献一头牛和一只肥羊。

text_en: David danced before the Lord with all his might; David was girded with a linen ephod.
text_cn: 同时达味束着细麻的“厄弗得”，在上主面前尽力跳舞。

text_en: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the Lord with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet.
text_cn: 这样，达味与以色列全家大声欢呼，吹起号筒，将上主的约柜迎上来。

text_en: As the ark of the Lord came into the city of David, Michal daughter of Saul looked out of the window, and saw King David leaping and dancing before the Lord ; and she despised him in her heart.
text_cn: 当上主的约柜进入达味城时，撒乌耳的女儿米加耳，由窗内窥看，见达味王在上主面前跳跃舞蹈，心中就轻视他。

text_en: They brought in the ark of the Lord , and set it in its place, inside the tent that David had pitched for it; and David offered burnt offerings and offerings of well-being before the Lord .
text_cn: 他们将上主的约柜抬来，安置在预备好的地方，停在达味为约柜建立的帐幕中央；达味给上主奉献了全燔祭与和平祭。

text_en: When David had finished offering the burnt offerings and the offerings of well-being, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord of hosts,
text_cn: 达味献完了全燔祭与和平祭后，以万军上主的名祝福了百姓。

text_en: and distributed food among all the people, the whole multitude of Israel, both men and women, to each a cake of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins. Then all the people went back to their homes.
text_cn: 以后，分给所有百姓，全以色列民众，不论男女，每人一块饼，一块肉，一块葡萄干饼。然后百姓各自回了本家。

text_en: David returned to bless his household. But Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, “How the king of Israel honored himself today, uncovering himself today before the eyes of his servants’ maids, as any vulgar fellow might shamelessly uncover himself! ”
text_cn: 达味回来祝福本家时，撒乌耳的女儿米加耳出来迎接达味说：“以色列的君王今天多么荣耀！他今天在臣仆的婢女前赤身露体，活像一个赤身露体的小丑。”

text_en: David said to Michal, “It was before the Lord , who chose me in place of your father and all his household, to appoint me as prince over Israel, the people of the Lord , that I have danced before the Lord .
text_cn: 达味回答米加耳说：“在废弃你父和他全家，而选拔了我的上主面前，在派我为上主百姓以色列首领的上主面前，我甘愿舞蹈，

text_en: I will make myself yet more contemptible than this, and I will be abased in my own eyes; but by the maids of whom you have spoken, by them I shall be held in honor. ”
text_cn: 甘愿加倍卑贱我自己！我在你眼中被视为卑贱，但在你所说的婢女们前，我必受到尊敬。”

text_en: And Michal the daughter of Saul had no child to the day of her death.
text_cn: 从此撒乌耳的女儿米加耳，到死再没有生育。
